videos.caption: KUMINGA, ANT & LAMELO’S CRAZY BLIZZARD ADVENTURE! 💀🔥 (Target Center 3D Animation) Jonathan Kuminga touches down in negative thirty-degree Minneapolis, and the welcoming committee is pure, unfiltered comedy! 🚨❄️ Watch stylized 3D Pixar-style caricature versions of Anthony Edwards, LaMelo Ball, and Jonathan Kuminga navigate the wildest trade initiation in basketball history across 12 hilarious scenes! From getting his Atlanta gear thrown straight into a blizzard from a high-speed pink snowmobile to getting styled in custom neon-green fur coats and diamond ski goggles at Mall of America, JK quickly learns the new Minnesota rules. There are no offensive sets—just 50-foot step-backs, pure vibes, and strict fines for looking at Rudy Gobert in the post! When a lurking Rudy corners Kuminga in the tunnel demanding post touches, Ant and Melo trigger a full “Code Red” panic sprint straight to center court! 🏀🔥 Drop a comment below: Are the Wolves winning 65 games with this lineup, or is Rudy demanding a trade by Christmas? 👇🏆 #NBA #AnthonyEdwards #JonathanKuminga #LaMeloBall #Timberwolves
